integrity: The source defines the polytope; its results on normality, facets, face structure and diameter are not claimed as new. Universal results are proved analytically, finite checks are corroborative, and independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the complete bipartite fixed-cardinality matching (assignment) polytopes, with Frobenius metric, are classified; the general bipartite-graph case and John ellipsoids are not addressed. Unindexed earlier equivalences cannot be eliminated completely.
title: Exact Löwner ellipsoids and saturation anisotropy of fixed-cardinality assignment polytopes
